# command channel

Claim automatic authority and write as the current task or loop.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `statement.command` |
| Origin | DCode |
| Category | Statements |
| Family | Authority |
| Monaco kind | `statement` |
| Format | `command \|portal/channel.value\| = <value>` |
| Valid contexts | `caesar_execution`, `shared_helper` |
| Autocomplete | `command \|portal/channel.value\| = value` |

## Example

```lua
command |portal/channel.value| = value
```
